next.reason: 1985: 'COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1'; 2023: 'COLUMN|COLUMNS|COL|COLS NUMBER(S) [IS|ARE] {LEFT|CENTER|RIGHT} {integer-1 | {PLUS|+} integer-2} …'. The 2023 format still accepts the 1985 form. It adds cases: synonyms, CENTER/RIGHT alignment, PLUS relative columns and repeated column entries. The 1985 format refuses these.
